GROUP: Execution plans: | - ESC:7119-7129. After 8 reference shells the walk continues with the unpeeled reference. Reader: "probably benign", not traced.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - ESC:10538-10543, 10590, 10597. A state with a non-primitive scalar parameter is skipped whole; `record_completion` results discarded. A state is left with no computation plans.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - ESC:6697-6733. Empty cleanup span on any failed precondition: a fresh reference receiver whose retirement lookup fails would skip normal cleanup actions.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - ETU:1212-1240. Alias resolution returns the partly rebased place after 16 steps or a failed lookup: a chain of 17 or more reference-copy aliases would resolve to an intermediate local.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - ETU:2359-2364. `Dynamic | ActivationStorage | DescriptorTable` call routes get no dependency edge and no check: a body calling through such a route is kept even if the called implementation has no plan.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - ETU:3374-3380 with ETU:500-501, and SSS:1006-1009. A failed receiver-alias lookup becomes an empty alias list; an unresolved alias keeps the authored place. An atomic place or a store through an erased `&mut` alias would be planned against the alias local.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - ETU:6403. Value kinds not listed contribute no transfers: a `Scalar`, `QuotientCall`, `QuotientAdaptation`, `ZeroedStructural` or `ByteLiteralView` value whose subtree moves an owned source would record no transfer. The reader notes ESC:4995-4996 requires Unrestricted input for the quotient adaptation arm.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - ETU:5116-5164. Operation and binding kinds not listed contribute no transfers. No wrong program named.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - CALLS:5678-5691. A projected mutable borrow rooted at an expression returns `StructuralResult` without the exact access check.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - CALLS:6172-6174. Qualification rows with an unknown domain are removed from the plan rather than rejected.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - CLEAN:929-991. `consumed_claims` returns an empty list when no event matches: a hook on a path whose linear claim was never recorded is not refused here.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - CTRL:398-402. Reference outputs skipped for checked families and descriptor-preserving interrupts.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - CTRL:2546-2563; CTRL:1670. A byte-sequence predicate with no flow call, and an absent Guard root, record nothing and succeed.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - CTRL:1881-1898. Remaining statement calls are accepted if retired, builtin with an empty write frame, or on another arm: a call wrongly marked retired would go unscheduled.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - SEQ:1350; SEQ:5502-5506; SEQ:7230-7232; SEQ:7208-7221 and 6770-6783; SEQ:9224-9228. Nothing planned for an erased dispatch subject; a loan not yet formed counts as retired; no releases when there is no normal completion or no loans; fact-only citations skipped. No wrong program identified for any.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - SG:3568-3570; SG:3571-3581. Unrestricted results, and no-code completion owners, pass with no cleanup check or disposition row.

"Stated" for intent ("the arms are not executed", SG:9251-9254); "open" for whether an arm can carry runtime effects.
GROUP: Execution plans: | - SG:7362-7372. When `add_reference_type` fails the carrier identity becomes the default value and the plan proceeds.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - SSS:3061-3088; SSS:3051-3056. Assignments that fail planning but have a call or structural value, and atomic or array assignments, are skipped on the assumption another builder takes them.

GROUP: Execution plans: | - TYPES:4786-4872, 1093, 4653-4659, 4760-4762. Memberships skipped when the root, domain definition or routing is missing; whether the scalar lane catches them was not traced.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:742-748. A borrow call whose caller or callee does not resolve adds no grouping edge: dependent machines could land in separate groups.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:1273-1353. A state or call with no reach summary gets the default summary: a state missing from the operational plan that does suspend. The `Default` impls were not read.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:1469, 1506; F:1524-1539. A store to a destination without static identity is not recorded, so the older snapshot stands; a join of zero predecessors makes an empty join node.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:1647-1678, 1618-1621, 1780-1784. An unresolved descriptor returns `Some(empty)`, not `None`; in `address_before_statement` the address then vanishes from the output.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:2741-2775. For exit contexts a fact whose root has no valid target origin is still published with its unrebased root.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:3687-3689, 3729-3734. `possible` is false for an unresolvable selection; callers skip on false (checks_multiplicity.rs:6568, 6592; checks_contracts.rs:5760).

GROUP: Flow: | - F:4146-4165; F:4166-4174. The expression-form operator effect returns early when operands cannot be rebuilt, and drops a mutable operand with no place, where the statement form reports unknown (F:4292-4296): facts about that operand would not be dropped.

GROUP: Flow: | - F:4432-4449. An `ensures` with no operand place is published at `FactPlace::Unknown` and no write ever invalidates it (traced at F:7056-7071); open whether expressions with only unplaceable operands end up here.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:4652-4656. A state with no borrow state fact gets no flow state row.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:6609-6641. A domain with no predicate, aliases or memberships is content independent, so content writes would not invalidate its qualification.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:6913-6920. A fact whose place root is `Unknown` or invalid survives every write.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:8110-8138; F:8896-8904. A `Name` that does not resolve to a symbol-rooted place records no receiver read; without published flow only the value write frame is checked.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:9282. `Unknown` and every borrow-resource constraint are kept regardless of the active contexts.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:9426-9482, 9732-9753. Machines, calls and events that fail a lookup add no dependency row; exposure defaults to private.

GROUP: Flow: | - F:10617-10619; F:10869-10874, 10964-10968; F:10759-10768; F:10799-10804. `zero_image` gives no cleanup leaves; a `DynamicTrait` value with an owner cleanup gets no edge; dispositions of non-checked-body, open or proof machines and leaves whose machine has no entry state are skipped.
GROUP: Flow: | - F:11515. A selector cycle contributes no origins.
GROUP: Flow: | - FCP:836-857. Contract facts about non-parameter occurrences (no place, non-symbol root, no position) are never invalidated by this filter.

GROUP: Flow: | - FCP:775-777; FCP:1394-1399; FCP:2068-2069, 2088. A source rooted in a temporary survives writes; a `ParameterReferent` incoming reference always survives a call; an unmatched mutation "does not affect the fact".
GROUP: Flow: | - FC:420-424. A carry fact transfers when its rendered label equals the source's label even if the places differ.
GROUP: Flow: | - FX:1433-1436. An exit with zero or several outgoing rows is recorded with invalid `returned_value` and `completed_storage`.
GROUP: Flow: | - FE:601-604, 720. A projected pointer with no stored capture is kept with its referents dropped.
GROUP: Flow: | - FM:1491-1500, 1512. A failed declaration lookup makes a place count as declared storage: a write through a reference-typed local would be recorded as a write to the local itself.

GROUP: Flow: | - FM:4612. `.or(Some(places))` keeps the unclosed places when alias closure fails, though the doc comment says "An unresolved origin requires full invalidation" (FM:4571): facts would be retired only at the directly written place.

GROUP: Flow: | - FM:4593; FM:3879, 3897, 4047-4051; FM:1283-1289. Non-assignment statements write nothing here; fact-only, byte-predicate and empty-frame calls write nothing; image-storage origins add no alias.
GROUP: Flow: | - FO:1257-1269. A context with zero descriptor observation rows agrees.
GROUP: Flow: | - FOC:111-114. A case path counts as not inactive when evidence cannot be prepared.
GROUP: Flow: | - FOW:67-69; FOW:869-874, 909-911. An unresolved callee records no move events; a place-like expression with no ownership place is neither moved nor observed.
GROUP: Flow: | - FP:1012 (source mutability below an immutable root not checked); FP:1241 (any valid expression root is a stable subject).
GROUP: Flow: | - FRP:526-531, 858-860. A symbol-rooted place not explained as a local or parameter is accepted as its own storage.
GROUP: Flow: | - FRB:1271-1281, 1368-1391. No handbacks when argument sources or ending inputs are missing; a loan not recognized as owing is handed back.
GROUP: Flow: | - FSV:518-541. A lexical-region delivery that is skipped leaves the state with no row, and "A missing row is unreachable" (FSV:2764).

GROUP: Flow: | - FT:3599-3602. Values are kept across a Unit call when `observation_places` is empty; the comment says "complete storage footprint is empty" (FT:2275-2278). A callee writing through a path not in `observation_places`.

GROUP: Flow: | - FT:1085-1115. For a non-exact target a candidate keeps a membership if any one source context proves it (`any`, not `all`): a write through a reference local with several possible referents.
